title: Koh Samet: the puppy comes out of the taxi
kaylee: Before: if she walked off after the puppy jumped in the taxi, he stayed in it forever and the taxi waited with him. After: a few seconds later he hops out and runs after her (or at once when she calls him), then shows the way again.

links.label: Na Dan, only the snorkel left: let him jump in, then walk off
Tune when he hops out (feel lab)
